title: Sample: keep the endpoint up
description: A minimal, genuinely reachable AWS Battle. The deploy stands up a public Lambda Function URL that returns HTTP 200; the uptime-flat scorer probes it every tick and awards points while it stays up. Near-zero cost (Lambda free tier). The verified AWS anchor for a future cross-cloud composite.
